title: Reduce valid matched-packet parking by V+r steps (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A new two-tape finite controller stores parked packets in reverse order and removes one POP scan from ywz65's PR2635 valid matched-packet interface.

```text
PUSH: find the packet end, copy backward into a reversed record
POP:  copy backward through that record into the forward packet port, rewind
```

For matched payload volume V, r packet pairs and d frame pairs, complete parking steps fall from the cited `5V+7r+3d` to `4V+6r+3d`. Reads and unit head moves each save `2V+2r`; writes and occupied storage are unchanged. Both PUSH and POP now cost `2n+3` steps. Nine states give a complete 441-entry table over the same two tapes and seven-symbol alphabet.

Claim type: new finite controller with a scoped written all-size proof and exact finite corroboration. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ywz65/PR2635 for the matched-record contract, finite model and published invoice, and its PR2574/2534/2483/2250/2287 physical/native/compiler lineage. Reversed stack storage is classical. The predecessor construction and numbers are cited premises, not an audit or replay deliverable. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

The [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19372174) precedes construction. Sources, proof, limits and reproduction are in `research/reverse-record-parking/`.

## Evidence

- Before: PR2635's published POP costs `3n+4` steps. After: the new table executes exactly `2n+3`, including all reads, writes, markers and returned head moves.
- All 2,047 packets through length ten pass, totaling 18,434 payload bits. Complete BEGIN/PUSH/POP/END bills sum to `(92159,184318,86018,126980)` for steps/reads/writes/moves. The sparse interpreter and separately written dense-array interpreter share only the finite table and agree with the expected full packet/head/cell endpoints.
- Twenty-one translated cases run through length 16,384; the largest use sparse interpretation. Empty and unequal records nest through depths 1,2,7,32,129. Thirteen controls cover invalid tables, restored boundary rejections, five semantic mutations and the explicit malformed-port limitation. Checks remain active under optimized Python.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized commands passed locally in 1.109 and 1.113 seconds, respectively, under their separate 120-second limits. Registered replay, metadata/pins, exact seven-file commit bytes and declared source history pass at `99430b03b9792f43c99d099f5569855d3bf71455`.
- Official export and integrity checking pass. Both normal and optimized replays pass in a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`; all eight exported file hashes and modes remain unchanged.
- Environment: CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library. The verifier generates its file-hash-bound receipt on stdout and writes no output into the checkout.

Exact commands from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/reverse-record-parking/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/reverse-record-parking/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reverse-record-parking
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/reverse-record-parking --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may be substituted. Expected markers are `PASS_REVERSE_RECORD_PARKING`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Historical provenance checks require full Git history; direct replay has no predecessor runtime dependencies.

## Limitations

POP requires a blank destination port and trusted, well-bracketed commands. Unlike PR2635's preflight, it may modify earlier output cells before rejecting a later occupied cell. A literal counterexample is included. The stronger malformed-input no-write guarantee is not claimed; a caller requiring it owes a separate preflight.

All participants in a parking region must use the reversed format. Existing live forward-format records need a separately priced conversion. Arbitrary partial pops, hostile-command isolation, caller serialization, packet production/consumption, complete backing reserve and actual caller substitution remain open. This is not a shortest-controller theorem, admitted supplier or multiplication theorem. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.

## Open next questions

Bind one actual source-bound caller's matching whole-packet path to the new record format and replace its parking subbill, retaining every port, serialization and backing charge. Start by finding direct readers of forward-format records and determining whether the caller requires the predecessor's malformed-port preflight. Stop before claiming a full caller improvement if either compatibility obligation is unpaid.

## Related open work

- #4167 removes selected parent parking through shared closed engines; this package instead lowers the finite matched-packet parking tariff where parking remains. No whole-root price is transferred.
- #4172 proves source-action coupling for the retained parking codec and allocator histories; this new representation has its own literal action count and needs a separate caller substitution.
- #2235 supplies formal multitape, parking and restoration infrastructure under its own interfaces; this package supplies a different explicit matched-record table and a written proof, without a Lean refinement claim.

The live open-PR and Discussion refresh found no other open PR changing PR2635's packet-record representation. Searches do not cover unpublished work or arbitrary code diffs.
